evidence_channels.formalisation: Let C be the analytic-continuation operation that maps an electrically charged black-hole configuration in the five-dimensional U(1)^3 gauged-supergravity truncation to a spatial-circle soliton configuration with compact coordinate phi and magnetic gauge potentials proportional to dphi. The methodological claim is C(black_hole_fields) = (g, Phi1, Phi2, A1, A2, A3) with Phi1 = sqrt(2/3) ln(x), Phi2 = 0, A1 = q1 (x^(-1) - x0^(-1)) L dphi, A2 = q1 (x^(-1) - x0^(-1)) L dphi, A3 = q2 (x - x0) L dphi, Omega(x) = x^(2/3) eta/(x - 1), and F(x) = L^(-2) + ((x - 1)^2(q1^2 - q2^2 x))/(eta x^2); applying the S5 uplift then gives ds10_squared = Delta_tilde^(1/2) ds5_squared + L^2 Delta_tilde^(-1/2) sum_i Xi^(-1)(dmu_i^2 + mu_i^2(dvarphi_i + Ai/L)^2) and F5 = G5 + star G5.

source_span.verbatim: We find AdS soliton solutions in 5-dimensional gauged supergravity, obtained from the S5 compactification of type IIB, with a dilaton saturating the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound. The solutions depend on the value of the periodicity of an S1 cycle and the boundary values for two U(1) gauge fields, and give a scalar VEV in the dual field theory.
